title: Creating a Roblox studio alternative without the bad pr or safety issues, and you own 100% of your game, no royalties, publish anywhere. 🥰
author: DeWildAsh
selftext: Still a WIP so no download available yet.

comments.author: DeWildAsh
comments.body: Oh also has a desktop build and a web editor, writing mostly in js but thats slowly being phased out not completely but rust is handling the heavier stuff. Three programming languages Luau, js and visual scripting, renderer powered by Webgpu and rapier physics.
